title: SRD-GUARD: A Defense Framework of LLMs via Semantic Rewriting and Joint Multi-Model Scoring for Latent Intent Exposure
abstract: arXiv:2609.06540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet jailbreak attacks can conceal harmful intent through role-playing, fictional scenarios, or seemingly benign motivations. Existing inference-time defenses may miss disguised attacks or excessively refuse legitimate requests. We propose SRD-GUARD, a parameter-free, black-box defense framework that exposes concealed intent through semantic rewriting and consensus-based risk assessment. Given an input prompt, SRD-GUARD generates five semantically related rewrites that preserve the underlying objective while removing unnecessary contextual packaging. The original prompt and rewrites are jointly evaluated by multiple independent LLM-based safety scorers on a continuous risk scale. A decision module combines absolute risk thresholds with relative risk changes between the original and rewritten prompts to adaptively intercept, preserve, or warn on reque

translated_title: SRD-GUARD：一种通过语义重写与多模型联合评分以暴露潜在意图的大语言模型防御框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被部署于安全关键型应用中，然而越狱攻击可以通过角色扮演、虚构场景或看似无害的动机来隐藏其有害意图。现有的推理时防御机制可能漏掉伪装的攻击，或者过度拒绝合法的请求。我们提出了SRD-GUARD，这是一个无需参数调整的黑盒防御框架，通过语义重写和基于共识的风险评估来暴露隐藏的意图。给定一个输入提示，SRD-GUARD会生成五个语义相关的重写版本，这些重写版本在保留底层目标的同时去除了不必要的上下文包装。原始提示和重写版本由多个独立的大语言模型安全评分器在连续风险量表上进行联合评估。决策模块将绝对风险阈值与原始提示和重写提示之间的相对风险变化相结合，以自适应地对请求进行拦截、放行或警告。
tldr: SRD-GUARD是一种无需参数调整的黑盒防御框架，通过语义重写剥离提示中的伪装包装，并结合多个大语言模型评分器的联合风险评估，自适应地检测和拦截针对大语言模型的越狱攻击。
en_tdlr: SRD-GUARD is a parameter-free, black-box defense framework that exposes latent harmful intent in LLM jailbreak attacks by generating semantic rewrites to strip away contextual disguises and combining multi-model joint risk scoring with adaptive decision-making.
